summary: JEPA世界模型把连续latent递归输入预测器，量化误差不会像离散token一样重置。WM-Quant保留前三个encoder blocks的8-bit激活、浮点action/proprioception控制通路，并联合优化encoder范围和每个rollout step独立的predictor范围。 执行四个小型encoder blocks、共享线性递归预测器、浮点action通路、STE范围bank和30步joint calibration；不加载LeWM/DINO-WM，不运行图像编码或CEM，不实现Orin整数GEMM。 激活使用原文Eq1–2的整数zero-point；旧continuous-low网格错误已修并新增负控。
correction: Independent review caught a continuous-low lattice; fixed to integer zero-point Eq1–2 with literal-equation, exact-zero and clipping controls. Old proof and CPU diagnostics preserved; corrected source needs a new GPU freeze/run.
